protocol:
Sampling for RNA / Protein/ dissolved nutrients from phage infection experiments
At each time point, collect 10ml from each experimental bottle/tube into a 15ml conical tube, using a serological pipet.
Collect one 10ml sample for RNA and one 10ml sample for protein.
Spin tubes for 15 minutes at 4700 rpm (4816 x g) in a swinging bucket rotor.
If you wish to collect the cell-free fraction (e.g.
for analyzing dissolved inorganic or organic nutrients or phage particles): decant supernatants into labeled sterile 50 ml conical tubes.
We pool the RNA and protein supernatants together resulting in a 20ml combined supernatant.
If you do not wish to collect the cell-free fraction: decant supernatant into waste container.
Flash-freeze cell pellets in 15 ml tubes using liquid nitrogen; store pellets in -80°C freezer until later analysis.
If you are not collecting the cell-free fraction, stop here.
If you are collecting the cell-free fraction, go to Step 5.
Remove the plunger from a 20ml clean syringe.
Attach a new 0.2µm syringe filter to the syringe.
Pour your 20ml combined supernatant into the barrel of the syringe.
Replace plunger on the syringe and filter your 20ml supernatant into appropriate tubes for your downstream nutrient/phage analysis (we use a 15ml conical tube plus a 5ml snap-cap Eppendorf tube).
Repeat step 5 for each sample.
You can reuse the same syringe for replicates of the same condition/treatment.
Store 0.2µm filtered samples in -20ºC until analysis.
(if analyzing phage particles in the filtrate, store at 4ºC instead.)

parameters.container: appropriate tubes (15ml conical tube + 5ml snap-cap Eppendorf tube)

other.condition: if analyzing phage particles in filtrate

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
collect(container='15ml conical tube', reagent='sample from experimental bottle/tube', volume='10ml', tool='serological pipet', time_point='each time point')
collect(container='15ml conical tube', reagent='sample for RNA', volume='10ml')
collect(container='15ml conical tube', reagent='sample for protein', volume='10ml')
centrifuge(container='15ml conical tube', duration='15 minutes', speed='4700 rpm (4816 x g)', rotor_type='swinging bucket')
decant(container='labeled sterile 50ml conical tube', reagent='supernatant', condition='if collecting cell-free fraction')
pool(reagent='RNA and protein supernatants', volume='20ml')
decant(container='waste container', reagent='supernatant', condition='if not collecting cell-free fraction')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: freeze (container: 15ml tube, reagent: cell pellet, temperature: liquid nitrogen, other: {'method': 'flash-freeze'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
store(container='15ml tube', reagent='cell pellet', temperature='-80°C', duration='until later analysis')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: 20ml clean syringe, reagent: plunger)
# MANUAL: attach (container: 20ml clean syringe, reagent: 0.2µm syringe filter)
# MANUAL: pour (container: barrel of syringe, reagent: 20ml combined supernatant, volume: 20ml)
# MANUAL: replace (container: 20ml syringe, reagent: plunger)
# MANUAL: filter (container: appropriate tubes (15ml conical tube + 5ml snap-cap Eppendorf tube), reagent: 20ml supernatant, volume: 20ml, other: {'filter': '0.2µm syringe filter'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
store(container='appropriate tubes', reagent='0.2µm filtered samples', temperature='-20ºC', duration='until analysis')
store(container='appropriate tubes', reagent='0.2µm filtered samples (phage particle analysis)', temperature='4ºC', duration='until analysis', condition='if analyzing phage particles in filtrate')
